title_zh: 询问旧商店改图书馆提案的意见提交方式

scenario.label_zh: 询问旧商店改图书馆提案的意见提交方式
scenario.goal_zh: 确认美国市议员办公室只在收集提案意见，并决定按公告提交出入口问题

context_zh: 虚构美国城镇场景，居民询问把空置商店改为图书馆的提案。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: Is the councilor supporting the conversion of the old grocery store into a library?

sentences.speaker: Aide
sentences.text: She has not taken a position yet. Her office is collecting comments before the public meeting.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: I like the idea, but the proposed entrance is far from the bus stop. Where can I raise that?

sentences.speaker: Aide
sentences.text: The meeting notice links to a comment form. You can describe the entrance concern there without taking a position on every part of the proposal.

sentences.speaker: Grace
sentences.text: I'll submit that question through the form and ask where the accessible entrance would be.

sentences.speaker: Aide
sentences.text: Please include the proposal number from the notice so your comment reaches the right file.
